import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Version;
import org.springframework.data.relational.core.mapping.Table;

/**
 * A short link. The id comes from {@code link_id_seq} before insert, so Spring Data JDBC decides
 * insert-vs-update from {@code version}: {@code null} means new.
 */
@Table("link")
public record Link(
    @Id Long id,
    String code,
    String originalUrl,
    boolean customAlias,
    LinkStatus status,
    String createdBy,
    Instant createdAt,
    Instant updatedAt,
    @Version Integer version) {

  public static Link newGenerated(
      long id, String code, String originalUrl, String createdBy, Clock clock) {
    Instant now = now(clock);
    return new Link(id, code, originalUrl, false, LinkStatus.ACTIVE, createdBy, now, now, null);
  }

  public static Link newAlias(
      long id, String alias, String originalUrl, String createdBy, Clock clock) {
    Instant now = now(clock);
    return new Link(id, alias, originalUrl, true, LinkStatus.ACTIVE, createdBy, now, now, null);
  }

  public boolean isActive() {
    return status == LinkStatus.ACTIVE;
  }

  /** Soft delete. Idempotent: deleting a deleted link returns it unchanged. */
  public Link markDeleted(Clock clock) {
    if (status == LinkStatus.DELETED) {
      return this;
    }
    return new Link(
        id,
        code,
        originalUrl,
        customAlias,
        LinkStatus.DELETED,
        createdBy,
        createdAt,
        now(clock),
        version);
  }

  /** Postgres timestamptz keeps microseconds; truncating keeps create and read responses equal. */
  private static Instant now(Clock clock) {
    return clock.instant().truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS);
  }

  // Withers used by Spring Data JDBC to populate generated values on an immutable record.
  Link withVersion(Integer version) {
    return new Link(
        id, code, originalUrl, customAlias, status, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt, version);
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.link;

import com.acme.shortener.cache.CacheEntry;
import com.acme.shortener.cache.LinkCache;
import com.acme.shortener.code.AliasTakenException;
import com.acme.shortener.code.AliasValidator;
import com.acme.shortener.code.CodeGenerator;
import com.acme.shortener.config.ShortenerProperties;
import com.acme.shortener.url.UrlValidator;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import java.net.URI;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.util.Objects;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;

@Service
public class LinkService {

  /** Generated codes are collision-free among themselves; this only covers an alias clash. */
  private static final int MAX_GENERATE_ATTEMPTS = 3;

  private final LinkRepository links;
  private final CodeGenerator codeGenerator;
  private final AliasValidator aliasValidator;
  private final UrlValidator urlValidator;
  private final LinkCache cache;
  private final Clock clock;
  private final String baseUrl;

  // shortener.create / shortener.resolve, tagged by outcome; histograms for p95/p99 (NFR-1).
  private final Timer createCreated;
  private final Timer createFailed;
  private final Timer resolveFound;
  private final Timer resolveNotFound;
  private final Timer resolveError;

  public LinkService(
      LinkRepository links,
      CodeGenerator codeGenerator,
      AliasValidator aliasValidator,
      UrlValidator urlValidator,
      LinkCache cache,
      Clock clock,
      ShortenerProperties properties,
      MeterRegistry meters) {
    this.links = links;
    this.codeGenerator = codeGenerator;
    this.aliasValidator = aliasValidator;
    this.urlValidator = urlValidator;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.baseUrl = properties.baseUrl();
    this.createCreated = timer(meters, "shortener.create", "created");
    this.createFailed = timer(meters, "shortener.create", "failed");
    this.resolveFound = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "found");
    this.resolveNotFound = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "not_found");
    this.resolveError = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "error");
  }

  public LinkResponse create(CreateLinkRequest request, String owner) {
    Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start();
    try {
      URI url = urlValidator.validate(request.url());
      String alias = request.customAlias();
      Link saved =
          (alias == null || alias.isEmpty())
              ? createGenerated(url.toString(), owner)
              : createAlias(alias, url.toString(), owner);
      afterCommit(() -> cache.putFound(saved.code(), saved.originalUrl()));
      sample.stop(createCreated);
      return LinkResponse.of(saved, baseUrl);
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      sample.stop(createFailed);
      throw e;
    }
  }

  /** Redirect target for an active link. Public: no ownership check. Cache, then DB. */
  public URI resolve(String code) {
    Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start();
    CacheEntry entry;
    try {
      entry = cache.get(code).orElseGet(() -> loadIntoCache(code));
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      sample.stop(resolveError);
      throw e;
    }
    return switch (entry) {
      case CacheEntry.Found found -> {
        sample.stop(resolveFound);
        yield URI.create(found.originalUrl());
      }
      case CacheEntry.NotFound notFound -> {
        sample.stop(resolveNotFound);
        throw new LinkNotFoundException(code);
      }
    };
  }

  private static Timer timer(MeterRegistry meters, String name, String outcome) {
    return Timer.builder(name)
        .tag("outcome", outcome)
        .publishPercentileHistogram()
        .register(meters);
  }

  private CacheEntry loadIntoCache(String code) {
    return links
        .findByCode(code)
        .filter(Link::isActive)
        .<CacheEntry>map(link -> {
          cache.putFound(code, link.originalUrl());
          return new CacheEntry.Found(link.originalUrl());
        })
        .orElseGet(() -> {
          cache.putNotFound(code);
          return CacheEntry.NOT_FOUND;
        });
  }

  /** Metadata for the owner, including deleted links (status DELETED). */
  public LinkResponse get(String code, String owner) {
    return LinkResponse.of(findOwned(code, owner), baseUrl);
  }

  /** Soft delete. Idempotent: deleting a deleted link succeeds. */
  public void delete(String code, String owner) {
    Link link = findOwned(code, owner);
    if (link.isActive()) {
      links.save(link.markDeleted(clock));
      // KNOWN-ISSUE BF-1: cache not invalidated on delete. A deleted link keeps redirecting from
      // L1/L2 until its cache TTL expires (L1 5m, L2 24h). Seeded on purpose for the brownfield
      // scenario; see docs/known-issues.md. Do not fix outside that scenario.
    }
  }

  /** The link if {@code owner} created it, including deleted ones; otherwise 404. */
  public Link findOwned(String code, String owner) {
    // Another key's link answers 404 too, so existence isn't revealed.
    return links
        .findByCode(code)
        .filter(link -> Objects.equals(link.createdBy(), owner))
        .orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
  }

  private Link createAlias(String alias, String url, String owner) {
    aliasValidator.validate(alias);
    try {
      return links.save(Link.newAlias(links.nextId(), alias, url, owner, clock));
    } catch (
        RuntimeException e) { // DataAccessException, or Spring Data's DbActionExecutionException
      if (isDuplicateKey(e)) {
        throw new AliasTakenException(alias); // lost a race; the unique index decided
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }

  private Link createGenerated(String url, String owner) {
    // Checked before insert rather than caught after: a failed INSERT aborts the surrounding
    // Postgres transaction (the idempotency transaction), so it can't be retried in place.
    for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_GENERATE_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
      CodeGenerator.GeneratedCode next = codeGenerator.next();
      if (links.findByCode(next.code()).isEmpty()) {
        return links.save(Link.newGenerated(next.id(), next.code(), url, owner, clock));
      }
      // A custom alias already uses this exact code; take the next id.
    }
    throw new IllegalStateException("could not allocate a free code");
  }

  /** Runs after the surrounding transaction commits, or now if there is none. */
  private static void afterCommit(Runnable action) {
    if (TransactionSynchronizationManager.isSynchronizationActive()) {
      TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
          new TransactionSynchronization() {
            @Override
            public void afterCommit() {
              action.run();
            }
          });
    } else {
      action.run();
    }
  }

  private static boolean isDuplicateKey(Throwable e) {
    for (Throwable t = e; t != null; t = t.getCause()) {
      if (t instanceof DuplicateKeyException) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.cache;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Ticker;
import io.github.resilience4j.circuitbreaker.CircuitBreaker;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Counter;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.function.Supplier;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

/**
 * L1 Caffeine (in-process, ~ns) → L2 Redis (shared, ~sub-ms) → caller falls back to the DB
 * (ADR-0003, DESIGN_RATIONALE §3.3).
 *
 * <p>Every Redis call goes through the "redis" circuit breaker. A failing or slow Redis (timeouts
 * are set on the client) counts as a miss; once the breaker opens, Redis is skipped entirely until
 * the half-open probe succeeds, so a Redis outage costs DB load, not latency.
 */
public final class TieredLinkCache implements LinkCache {

  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TieredLinkCache.class);

  public record Settings(long l1MaxSize, Duration l1Ttl, Duration l2Ttl, Duration negativeTtl) {}

  private final Cache<String, CacheEntry.Found> l1Found;
  private final Cache<String, CacheEntry.NotFound> l1NotFound;
  private final RemoteLinkCache l2;
  private final CircuitBreaker breaker;
  private final Settings settings;

  private final Counter l1Hits;
  private final Counter l1Misses;
  private final Counter l2Hits;
  private final Counter l2Misses;
  private final Counter redisFallbacks;

  public TieredLinkCache(
      RemoteLinkCache l2,
      CircuitBreaker breaker,
      Settings settings,
      MeterRegistry meters,
      Ticker ticker) {
    this.l2 = l2;
    this.breaker = breaker;
    this.settings = settings;
    // Negative entries live in their own L1 cache so their short TTL never shortens real entries.
    this.l1Found =
        Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(settings.l1MaxSize())
            .expireAfterWrite(settings.l1Ttl())
            .ticker(ticker)
            .build();
    this.l1NotFound =
        Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(settings.l1MaxSize())
            .expireAfterWrite(settings.negativeTtl())
            .ticker(ticker)
            .build();
    this.l1Hits = counter(meters, "cache.requests", "level", "l1", "result", "hit");
    this.l1Misses = counter(meters, "cache.requests", "level", "l1", "result", "miss");
    this.l2Hits = counter(meters, "cache.requests", "level", "l2", "result", "hit");
    this.l2Misses = counter(meters, "cache.requests", "level", "l2", "result", "miss");
    this.redisFallbacks = Counter.builder("cache.redis.fallback").register(meters);
    breaker
        .getEventPublisher()
        .onStateTransition(
            e -> log.warn("Redis circuit breaker {}", e.getStateTransition())); // once per change
  }

  @Override
  public Optional<CacheEntry> get(String code) {
    CacheEntry local = l1Found.getIfPresent(code);
    if (local == null) {
      local = l1NotFound.getIfPresent(code);
    }
    if (local != null) {
      l1Hits.increment();
      return Optional.of(local);
    }
    l1Misses.increment();

    Optional<CacheEntry> remote = guarded(() -> l2.get(code), Optional.empty());
    if (remote.isPresent()) {
      l2Hits.increment();
      putLocal(code, remote.get()); // promote to L1
    } else {
      l2Misses.increment();
    }
    return remote;
  }

  @Override
  public void putFound(String code, String originalUrl) {
    CacheEntry.Found entry = new CacheEntry.Found(originalUrl);
    putLocal(code, entry);
    guarded(
        () -> {
          l2.put(code, entry, settings.l2Ttl());
          return null;
        },
        null);
  }

  @Override
  public void putNotFound(String code) {
    putLocal(code, CacheEntry.NOT_FOUND);
    guarded(
        () -> {
          l2.put(code, CacheEntry.NOT_FOUND, settings.negativeTtl());
          return null;
        },
        null);
  }

  @Override
  public void evict(String code) {
    invalidateLocal(code);
    guarded(
        () -> {
          l2.delete(code);
          return null;
        },
        null);
  }

  /** Drops the code from this instance's L1 only. */
  public void invalidateLocal(String code) {
    l1Found.invalidate(code);
    l1NotFound.invalidate(code);
  }

  /** Drops all of this instance's L1 (tests, ops). */
  public void invalidateAllLocal() {
    l1Found.invalidateAll();
    l1NotFound.invalidateAll();
  }

  private void putLocal(String code, CacheEntry entry) {
    switch (entry) {
      case CacheEntry.Found found -> {
        l1NotFound.invalidate(code);
        l1Found.put(code, found);
      }
      case CacheEntry.NotFound notFound -> {
        l1Found.invalidate(code);
        l1NotFound.put(code, notFound);
      }
    }
  }

  /** Runs a Redis call through the breaker; any failure (or open breaker) yields the fallback. */
  private <T> T guarded(Supplier<T> call, T fallback) {
    try {
      return breaker.executeSupplier(call);
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      redisFallbacks.increment();
      log.debug("Redis call skipped or failed, falling back: {}", e.toString());
      return fallback;
    }
  }

  private static Counter counter(MeterRegistry meters, String name, String... tags) {
    return Counter.builder(name).tags(tags).register(meters);
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.Optional;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;

/**
 * L2 in Redis. One key per code: {@code link:{code}} holding {@code U:<url>} for a link or {@code
 * N} for a negative entry, so a later create simply overwrites a negative entry.
 */
public final class RedisLinkCache implements RemoteLinkCache {

  static final String KEY_PREFIX = "link:";
  private static final String FOUND = "U:";
  private static final String NOT_FOUND = "N";

  private final StringRedisTemplate redis;

  public RedisLinkCache(StringRedisTemplate redis) {
    this.redis = redis;
  }

  @Override
  public Optional<CacheEntry> get(String code) {
    String value = redis.opsForValue().get(KEY_PREFIX + code);
    if (value == null) {
      return Optional.empty();
    }
    if (value.startsWith(FOUND)) {
      return Optional.of(new CacheEntry.Found(value.substring(FOUND.length())));
    }
    return Optional.of(CacheEntry.NOT_FOUND);
  }

  @Override
  public void put(String code, CacheEntry entry, Duration ttl) {
    String value =
        switch (entry) {
          case CacheEntry.Found found -> FOUND + found.originalUrl();
          case CacheEntry.NotFound notFound -> NOT_FOUND;
        };
    redis.opsForValue().set(KEY_PREFIX + code, value, ttl);
  }

  @Override
  public void delete(String code) {
    redis.delete(KEY_PREFIX + code);
  }
}

  @ExceptionHandler(RateLimitedException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> rateLimited(RateLimitedException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)
        .headers(RateLimitHeaders.of(e.decision()))
        .body(

  /** Last resort. Logged with the stack trace; the client never sees internals. */
  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ProblemDetail unexpected(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    log.error("Unhandled error on {} {}", request.getMethod(), request.getRequestURI(), e);
    return problem(
        HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        ProblemTypes.INTERNAL_ERROR,
        "an unexpected error occurred",
        request);
  }

  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleMethodArgumentNotValid(
      MethodArgumentNotValidException e,
      HttpHeaders headers,
      HttpStatusCode status,
      WebRequest request) {
    ProblemDetail problem =
        problem(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
            ProblemTypes.VALIDATION_FAILED,
            "request has invalid fields",
            servletRequest(request));
    List<Map<String, String>> errors =
        e.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream()
            .map(f ->
                Map.of(
                    "field",
                    f.getField(),
                    "message",
                    f.getDefaultMessage() == null ? "invalid" : f.getDefaultMessage()))
            .toList();
    problem.setProperty("errors", errors);
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(problem);
  }

  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleHttpMessageNotReadable(
      HttpMessageNotReadableException e,
      HttpHeaders headers,
      HttpStatusCode status,
      WebRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
        .body(
            problem(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                ProblemTypes.MALFORMED_REQUEST,
                "request body is missing or is not valid JSON",
                servletRequest(request)));
  }

  /** A query or path parameter of the wrong type, e.g. {@code ?from=yesterday}. */
  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleTypeMismatch(
      TypeMismatchException e, HttpHeaders headers, HttpStatusCode status, WebRequest request) {
    String name = e.getPropertyName() == null ? "parameter" : "'" + e.getPropertyName() + "'";
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
        .body(
            problem(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                ProblemTypes.VALIDATION_FAILED,
                name + " has an invalid value",
                servletRequest(request)));
  }

  private static ProblemDetail problem(
      HttpStatus status, ProblemTypes.Type type, String detail, HttpServletRequest request) {
    ProblemDetail problem = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(status, detail);
    problem.setType(type.uri());
    problem.setTitle(type.title());
    problem.setInstance(URI.create(request.getRequestURI()));
    String correlationId = MDC.get(CorrelationIdFilter.MDC_KEY);
    if (correlationId != null) {
      problem.setProperty("correlationId", correlationId); // matches the logs for this request
    }
    return problem;
  }

  private static HttpServletRequest servletRequest(WebRequest request) {
    return ((ServletWebRequest) request).getRequest();
  }

    List<Future<MvcResult>> results = new ArrayList<>();

    try (ExecutorService pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(threads)) {
      for (int i = 0; i < threads; i++) {

            () -> {

              return mvc.perform(create(body).header("Idempotency-Key", key)).andReturn();

        results.add(pool.submit(call));

      start.countDown();

      List<String> codes = new ArrayList<>();
      int fresh = 0;
      for (Future<MvcResult> f : results) {
        MvcResult r = f.get();
        assertThat(r.getResponse().getStatus()).isEqualTo(201);
        if ("false".equals(r.getResponse().getHeader("Idempotent-Replayed"))) {
          fresh++;
        }
        Map<?, ?> parsed = json.readValue(r.getResponse().getContentAsString(), Map.class);
        codes.add((String) parsed.get("code"));

      assertThat(fresh).isEqualTo(1);
      assertThat(codes).containsOnly(codes.get(0));
    }
